none: PAS ESS-0864DD: A Roman silver radiate of Gordian III (AD 238-244).
contea di ritrovamento: Bedford (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver radiate of Gordian III (AD 238-244). Reece period 12. the coin is very worn, but the radiate bust is visible on the obverse with the inscription [---] AVG. The reverse depicts a female standing left, though no further detail can be discerned. Dimensions: diameter: 21.12 mm; weight: 2.06g
